Re-running dispatch-profile from an independent archived code root with sibling fixture roots passed. The broader remote lifecycle runner passed the altered seed/receiver regressions and later hit the existing gate guard from a fixture cwd nested under the gate; a separate disposable Git root and a focused seed/receiver prefix rerun passed. Driver setup issues (unsupported remote multiword names, raw relaunch syntax, native jq on /usr/bin, missing minimal-PATH core utilities, and concurrent fixture inventory changes) were corrected and relevant scenarios re-driven. These were setup failures, not target product failures.
transport_limit: Remote sender/receiver registry regression ran through the existing deterministic SSH boundary. Native SSH remote readiness was not driven: an isolated ready remote account was unavailable, and the local readiness auto-repair would alter the operator Aqua/launchd Herdr and remote-job namespace. Docker, Podman and QEMU guest runtimes were not on PATH. No fresh live-vendor SSH transport proof is claimed.
